sections.title: Service
sections.description: The endpoint receives a JSON POST with the username, password, client id, peer address, protocol version and whether MQTT is encrypted. HTTPS is required outside loopback; a custom CA replaces system trust for this endpoint only.

sections.title: Limits and decision cache
sections.description: One deadline covers connect, TLS and HTTP. Only allow and deny answers are cached, under a keyed hash of the whole request; malformed answers, timeouts and outages are refused and never remembered. An outage cannot become a remembered admission or refusal.
